resolution.note: fix(deliver): run hygiene when the main gate fails after the merge (t-5hh171q)

title: deliver runs hygiene when the main gate fails after the merge
body:
Outcome: after ship merges the PR, `krn deliver` (and `krn slice run`) runs hygiene (retire branch and worktree, archive review-series state, fast-forward main) even when the main krn/gate then fails, and still exits 74 naming the main cause; a rerun after a red main gate does not wait forever for it.
Evidence: PR #207 merged as a41c870; main krn/gate failed before the gate ran (GitHub check readback failed, gate=false); deliver exited 74 with worktree .krn/worktrees/verify-cause, branch fix/verify-cause and local main at 80a5299 left behind; the lead fast-forwarded and removed them by hand.
Proof: an observer whose stub main gate fails after ship asserts the hygiene calls ran and the exit is 74.
Lead trap: when deliver exits 74 on a red main gate after the merge, confirm the merged tree equals the PR head (`git diff --quiet <pr-head> <merge>`), then `git merge --ff-only <merge>`, `git worktree remove <worktree>`, `git branch -D <branch>` from the main checkout.
